entries.german: "Dundorffer Amtsrepertorium",  1756 begonnen und fortgeführt von Johannes Petrus Nitribitt, Wzb. Hof- und Regierungsrat, kaiserlicher Landgerichtsconsulent, Frhr. von Rosenbach'scher Obervogt
entries.english: “Dundorff administrative register,” begun in 1756 and continued by Johannes Petrus Nitribitt, Würzburg court and government councillor, imperial provincial court consultant, chief bailiff of the Freiherr von Rosenbach family.
